plan: Represent the adapted recipe as fresh copies: shallow-copied ingredient dicts with Fraction quantities pre-multiplied by target_yield/original_yield, copied instruction list, and an equipment set, so inputs are never mutated.

Resolve substitutions with a worklist of (container, ingredient) pairs: while an ingredient's name is excluded, pick the catalog choice minimizing (priority, catalog index), apply result fields (name, quantity_factor, unit, preparation, wording_changes, equipment add/remove, yield_factor), and append any additional ingredients to the worklist so they undergo the same exclusion and catalog processing (chaining).

Detect cycles with a per-chain seen-set of names: a replacement that is excluded and already seen yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME'; one that is excluded but new yields a warning and another loop iteration.

Accumulate all impossibility reasons in a set instead of failing fast: missing substitutions and cycles during resolution, then a post-pass checking every required equipment item against available_equipment; return sorted reasons with recipe=null, or the adapted recipe with sorted equipment, sorted warnings, ordered choice IDs, and empty reasons.

Apply wording changes as global str.replace over instructions and all preparations; rescale all quantities by the accumulated inverse yield_factor at the end so the recipe lands exactly on target_yield.

Ship an executable acceptance suite under __main__ covering: 3→5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion warning, additional-ingredient chaining, yield-changing substitution, multiple simultaneous reasons, cycle detection, deterministic priority with tie-break, and byte-for-byte original preservation with a deep-copy snapshot.
mechanisms: min-key deterministic selection: best catalog choice = min over (priority, catalog_index)
worklist-driven chained substitution over ingredient records, including catalog-introduced additional ingredients
per-chain seen-set cycle detection producing 'substitution cycle involving NAME'
accumulating reason/warning sets sorted at return time so all independent impossibility reasons are reported
global textual rewrite (str.replace) of instructions and preparations for wording changes
equipment modeled as a set with add/discard plus a post-resolution availability pass
Fraction ratio scaling (target/original) plus terminal inverse yield_factor rescale
defensive copying for purity; print_original returns authored_text unchanged
self-test harness under __main__ asserting the executable acceptance contract
